title: Cerebus Jaka's Story 13 September #126 Aarevark-Vanaheim Comic Book - Dave Sim
descriptionText:
Dive into the world of "Cerebus Jaka's Story 13" with issue number 126, a compelling addition to any comic book collection. Published by Aardvark-Vanaheim in September 1989, this single issue is a product of the vibrant Copper Age of comics. It comes boarded for preservation and is a must-have for fans of the series and the genre alike.

Crafted by the talented Dave Sim, this comic book features the iconic character Cerebus in a narrative that's both engaging and reflective of the era's storytelling traditions. Whether you're a long-time collector or new to the series, this comic book promises to be a noteworthy piece in your assortment.
